sourceText: Operator standing directive: complete Workstream 2 of the repro-first / language-neutral gates program by implementing the DONE trusted RED-evidence subsystem spec (docs/requirements/decisions/red-evidence-subsystem-spec.md) section by section. W2a is the foundation leaf: land a single RFC 8785 CANON canonicalizer that the whole subsystem digests through, plus the fail-closed policy resolver that owns the §1.2 policy table/registries and the §1.12 hard safety floors, surfaced non-gating in lattice doctor. Diagnostic-only; the enforcement flip is reserved for W3.
normalizedOutcome: After this story lands, running `lattice doctor` prints one new red-evidence policy line — showing `red_evidence_policy_missing: pinnedPath` while no redEvidence block is configured on the host — and the red-evidence-policy-canon-smoke passes in the full validate suite, mechanically proving CANON is a distinct RFC 8785 leaf (it disagrees with core/digest.ts and authority-signing on frozen vectors) and that the 14-key policy resolver fails closed on every §1.12 floor, forbidden env key, relative/missing pinnedPath, unknown key, invariance catch-all, and unresolvable argv placeholder.
acceptanceClaim: The red-evidence-policy-canon-smoke passes: CANON differs from digestCanonicalJson and canonicalJsonForSigning on the frozen key-order/null/number vectors, the default policySnapshot digests to a frozen sha256 literal, every §1.12 floor and forbidden-key/pinnedPath/unknown-key/catch-all/placeholder violation rejects with its distinct named diagnostic, and `lattice doctor` emits the policy line while its exit code and proofstory_gate_check output stay byte-identical.
